title: Core descent data for one finite quotient
statement: A Noetherian scheme X, an immersion g:Y→X, an adic coefficient datum d on A, a finite level n, a bounded derived object K, and relatively finite lisse inverse-image cohomology determine, for every etale V→Y, a descended level over the completion quotient on V whose cohomology is finite locally constant, whose cohomology vanishing follows that of K, and whose original relative lisse data persists on every proetale refinement.

proof.text: Apply inverse image and constant coefficient comparison, descend the bounded constructible finite-coefficient complex, transfer it across the completion quotient isomorphism, and pull its finite local models back to every refinement.

lean.statement:
theorem lisse_finite_quotient_etale_origin_core
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (g : Y ⟶ X) [IsImmersion g]
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (n : ℕ)
    (K : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))))
    (hbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, (q < a ∨ b < q) →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K))
    (hlisse : ∀ q : ℤ,
      IsRelativelyFiniteLisseModule g (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
        ((pbcRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage g).map
          (pbcLevelConstantComparison X d n).hom)).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
              ((adicTowerPullback g ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj K))))
    (V : Y.Etale) :
    Nonempty (LisseFiniteQuotientEtaleOriginCore X Y g d n K V)
